recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. It fixes invalid ConceptMap target codes and a missed parallel wording update without changing the approved design or editing generated diagram artifacts.
issue_request: FHIR-26696 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked to clarify ActionRelationshipType by adding the before/concurrent/after hierarchy, adding an optional end relationship element bound to the same code system, documenting that relationship applies to the start time of the action, and adding start/end ConceptMaps to v3 ActRelationshipType.
initial_application: PR HL7/fhir#2635 and J#26696 commits e43568d, f02760a, and f21a979 applied the hierarchy, PlanDefinition.action.relatedAction.endRelationship, PlanDefinition start-time wording, ConceptMaps, and a parallel RequestOrchestration endRelationship addition. The application left ConceptMap target codes SCWS and ECWE, which are not v3 ActRelationshipType codes, and left RequestOrchestration.action.relatedAction.relationship with the older generic definition.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has active PlanDefinition and RequestOrchestration resource entries, so the edited StructureDefinitions and resource-local terminology files are current build inputs. The Jira comment points to v3 timing codes; THO v3 ActRelationshipType contains SCW, SCWE, ECW, and ECWS but not SCWS or ECWE. Confluence Workflow minutes from 2020-04-06 record the relationship-code clarity discussion and FHIR-26696 creation, and exact Zulip search found no conflicting thread.
reconciliation: Changed source/plandefinition/conceptmap-start-relationship-type.xml so concurrent-with-start maps to SCW, changed source/plandefinition/conceptmap-end-relationship-type.xml so concurrent-with-end maps to ECW, and changed source/requestorchestration/structuredefinition-RequestOrchestration.xml so relatedAction.relationship is explicitly the relationship of the start of this action to the related action.
source_changes: source/plandefinition/conceptmap-start-relationship-type.xml: replaced invalid v3 target code SCWS with SCW for concurrent-with-start.
source/plandefinition/conceptmap-end-relationship-type.xml: replaced invalid v3 target code ECWE with ECW for concurrent-with-end.
source/requestorchestration/structuredefinition-RequestOrchestration.xml: clarified relatedAction.relationship as the relationship of the start of this action to the related action.
